ticket.subject: Gebruikers
ticket.body: Hoe kan ik een tweede beheerder toevoegen aan ons account?

decision.reason: How-to for adding a second administrator; the help centre covers adding employees (F02) but has no entry on admin roles, so a person answers.
decision.handoff_note: Customer wants to know how to add a second administrator (beheerder) to their account. Key facts: the ticket is on the Basis plan; the help centre covers adding employees (F02) but has no entry on admin roles, so the question is not answered. Next step: confirm how an administrator role is assigned in the account and send the customer those steps in Dutch.

ticket.subject: Rooster
ticket.body: Our whole team of 40 cannot see the shift plan since this morning. The app just shows a spinner.

decision.reason: Shift plan stuck on a spinner for a team of 40, so many users are blocked and the help centre has no fix (F11 only points to the status page).
decision.handoff_note: Customer wants the shift plan visible again for their whole team of 40. Key facts: Plus plan; since this morning all 40 staff see only a spinner when opening the shift plan, and the help centre (F11) only points to status.roosterly.nl and does not cover this bug. Next step: check for an ongoing outage and reproduce the spinner on this account now, and treat it as P1 because many users are blocked.  [Agent flags: llm_critical]

ticket.subject: Dagen
ticket.body: Kunt u mij vertellen hoeveel dagen per week de rooster-export maximaal kan bevatten?

decision.reason: F04 covers export per pay period but states no maximum number of days per week, so a person must confirm the limit.
decision.handoff_note: Customer wants to know the maximum number of days per week a roster export can contain. Key facts: F04 covers payroll export per pay period (week, four weeks or month) but gives no day limit; the customer is on the Basis plan per the ticket. Next step: confirm the export's day limit with product or engineering, then answer the customer.

ticket.subject: Prijsverhoging
ticket.body: Waarom staat er op de factuur van november €8 per medewerker? Wij betalen toch €6?

decision.reason: Disputed charge: the November invoice shows €8 per employee on Plus, while F05 states €6, so a person must check the invoice.
decision.handoff_note: Customer wants an explanation of why the November invoice shows €8 per employee, when they say they pay €6 on Plus. Key facts: F05 gives Plus at €6 per active employee per month, excl. VAT, and the help centre has no entry for a price change; the ticket reports Plus and the €8 invoice line. Next step: check the November invoice lines and the account's subscription price history before replying, and do not confirm or deny a price change until that is done.  [Agent flags: llm_critical]

ticket.subject: Hulp
ticket.body: Ich habe mein Passwort vergessen und die E-Mail kommt nicht an. Was kann ich tun?

decision.reason: Password-reset email not arriving; F01 gives the reset steps, the 60-minute link validity and the spam-folder check after 10 minutes.
decision.draft_reply: Hallo, öffnen Sie app.roosterly.nl/login und klicken Sie auf „Wachtwoord vergeten“ (Forgot password). Geben Sie Ihre E-Mail-Adresse ein. Der Link zum Zurücksetzen ist 60 Minuten gültig. Kommt innerhalb von 10 Minuten keine E-Mail, prüfen Sie bitte Ihren Spam-Ordner. Team Roosterly
decision.reply_english_gloss: Hello, open app.roosterly.nl/login and click "Wachtwoord vergeten" (Forgot password). Enter your email address. The reset link is valid for 60 minutes. If no email arrives within 10 minutes, please check your spam folder. Team Roosterly
